summary.text: Mark Weber is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 22 (home city listed as Casselton), serving since 2021 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Weber lists an occupation of Retired.
It lists education as BS, Mechanized Agriculture, NDSU; MS, Ag Econ., NDSU.

It also lists Past Executive Director, Northern Crops Institute, Red River Valley Sugarbeet Growers Association, Past Bank Director, Choice Financial Holdings, Member family farming partnership and St. Leo's Catholic Church.
Family is listed as: Married (Jadene); 2 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Weber's standing committee assignments as Finance and Taxation (chairman) and Agriculture and Veterans Affairs.
